verdict.rationale: The only startup-latency evidence is the template docs' claim of 'fully configured sandboxes with running processes ready to use with zero wait time'. The Firecracker microVM basis implies lightweight boot but states no timing. Neither gives a documented cold-start number or benchmark. Missing for 10: explicit documented cold-start latency figures (sub-second/few-second), benchmark or measured startup data, independent or hands-on corroboration of start times.
